_doc: Field map for the social.plus Blog Posts collection. Single source of truth for the blog's Webflow IDs, field slugs and category IDs (blog-publisher/webflow-config.md is the human-readable companion). Keys starting with '_' are documentation and ignored by scripts/webflow_fieldmap.py.

Alt text._doc: Standalone alt-text field; the alt inside each image object stays null (matches production).

Tags._doc: Always contains the main Category ID plus any secondary tag IDs.

_optional_fields.related-webinar-to-show-on-page: Reference → Webinars collection 66e2765d540e1939a89db84e. Set by blog-publisher Phase 6 (webinar matching) by adding the key to fielddata.json before publish.
_optional_fields.blog-id-3: PlainText. Only when the post must appear in a specific site location.
_optional_fields.name-careers-page: PlainText. Careers-page variant of the title.

_images_doc: The collection's image fields enforce exact dimensions (min=max validation); the API rejects anything off-size. Files are named {slug}_{variant}_{width}x{height}.webp.

slug_rules._doc: NON-NEGOTIABLE (blog-publisher/SKILL.md): a blog slug never contains a year or the leading listicle count, so '5 Best X' and a later '7 Best X (2027)' share one URL. Never resolve a slug collision by appending a suffix.
